def _parse_to_end(inline: 'InlineParser', m: Match[str], state:
    'InlineState', tok_type: str, end_pattern: Pattern[str]) ->Optional[int]:
    pos = m.end()
    src = state.src[pos:]
    end_m = end_pattern.search(src)
    if not end_m:
        return None
    end_pos = end_m.end()
    text = src[:end_pos]
    new_state = state.copy()
    new_state.src = text
    children = inline.render(new_state)
    state.append_token({
        'type': tok_type,
        'children': children
    })
    return pos + end_pos
